title: Leveraging a Longitudinal Genomics Platform to Recontact Patients Eligible for Hereditary Cancer Genetic Testing
summary: Transform patient care with AI built for genomics. Nest gives your health system a single platform to launch, coordinate, and scale genomic programs.
body_text: Introduction Genetic testing (GT) for hereditary cancer risk is increasingly accessible due to reduced testing costs, improved insurance coverage, expanded guidelines for testing, and greater public awareness. However, many patients still miss the GT opportunity due to lack of follow-up from providers and/or barriers (e.g., cost, time) present at the time eligibility for testing was determined. At a large, public GT company, only about 40% of patients found eligible via an online questionnaire actually complete testing. In the remaining 60%, little to no follow-up occurs. To increase GT uptake in a scalable and patient-centered way, the GT company partnered with a genetics software platform to pilot a digital recontact workflow. Methods Select clinics utilizing the GT company offered their patients an online risk assessment tool in the waiting room. This tool captures personal health and family cancer history to determine eligibility for GT. Between May 2024 and January 2025, eligible patients from 15 clinics were either consented or prompted to contact the GT company's patient education team if they had additional questions. For the initial recontact, eligible patients who did not complete GT were sent the digital educational outreach via SMS or email 3 months following the start of the pilot program. Thereafter, eligible patients received the digital outreach 2–3 weeks post online tool completion. Patients received up to 3 reminders. Following completion of an education module reviewing testing options, patients could either initiate testing or document their decision to decline. Patients who declined were asked reasons for declining. Results A total of 3,599 GT-eligible patients who had not completed GT were sent a link via SMS or email, 2,692/3,599 (75%) opened the link, and 1,758/2,692 (65%) completed the digital experience. 1,014/2,692 (58%) indicated interest in testing, 762/1,014 (75%) had orders placed and 460/762 (60%) submitted a sample by the end of the pilot. Overall, 12.7% (460/3,599) of patients sent a link subsequently completed GT, an increase of approximately 30% compared to the proportion of patients who typically complete GT. Among the individuals completing GT was a 27-year-old female negative for germline pathogenic mutations who had an elevated combined polygenic and Tyrer-Cuzick lifetime risk estimate of 31%, prompting baseline imaging that detected a stage 1 breast cancer. Among the 744 (42%) patients who declined GT after receiving the digital reminder, cost (119, 16%) and “not ready yet” (208, 28%) were the most commonly cited reasons, with “too busy” (12%), “won't impact my care” (7%), “I don't want to know” (5%), “privacy” (5%), “still have questions” (3%), “I do enough cancer screening” (2%), and “other” (17%) following. Conclusion Digital recontact is an effective and scalable approach to increase GT uptake among eligible patients. Given the success of this pilot, the digital recontact workflow is being implemented in several additional clinics. Iterative improvements to the digital outreach and workflow are underway to improve appropriate GT uptake on initial outreach, reducing the need for multiple recontact attempts.

title: Mapping the Market: AI Landscape for Private Finance
summary: We just published a deep dive of the AI finance market on our blog, breaking down the components of the market map we published last week. Learn more about some of the leading companies in the space and how buyers are navigating it in our latest article.
body_text: Since the start of 2024, we have spoken with nearly 250 leaders in the private equity industry with the aim of understanding customer needs in the finance AI solution space. We soon realized that buyers were finding it challenging to navigate the market landscape at all, given the overwhelming number of providers and different ways to build solutions across the stack. With AI, scoping a solution is particularly hard, because the market itself is still emerging and re-shaping itself month by month. We asked ourselves, “what solution set are PE investors considering when making the decision of whether to adopt AI?” We also investigated whether decision-makers were actually weighing whether to invest in proprietary model development against adopting point solutions, or other parts of the stack. Ultimately, these challenging questions are the driving force behind this article series. Our goal is to help you, as a business leader, begin to understand some of the dynamics connecting providers and buyers in this newly shaped landscape and make more informed decisions. What we learned Last week, we introduced the concept of the AI stack . The “stack” refers to the set of software and hardware components needed to run the AI applications coming to market. What is somewhat unique about the AI space, is that buyers show a much higher interest in adopting new tech in layers further down the stack, such as LLMs or data pipelines. This stands in contrast to other complex technology markets such as cloud computing, enterprise software or networking, where all but the largest enterprises typically start by using out-of-the-box or narrowly customizable applications. Adding to the already complex landscape of vertical AI solutions (sourcing, due diligence, portfolio management, etc.), firms are considering where in the stack to invest in order to support different functions, which has sometimes made adopting new technology paralyzingly difficult. For example, we spoke with multiple private equity firms who were considering building out their own AI-powered data pipelines and algorithms to help source new deals from data sets they had exposure to. In our last article , we shared examples of large funds who are actually using RLHF or fine-tuning to develop their own proprietary LLMs. According to Forbes, "KKR and Blackstone are leveraging AI to analyze market trends, evaluate potential investments, and enhance decision-making processes". Mapping the stack to the market map This tells us that clearer lines are indeed beginning to emerge between the two major markets. It’s also worth emphasizing that many firms, especially as we move up-market and model training becomes more accessible, are eyeing both ends of the spectrum. However, even this does not capture the full picture, as some firms will choose to work with consultants, while those consultants must also source their LLMs and data infrastructure from existing providers. Investors who do look further down the stack to build custom solutions will have many more decisions to make, from which models to use, to the integration between existing systems. A few sample components: Point solutions (applications) Off-the-shelf models For example, from CB Insights: [GPT-4] is among the largest and most costly AI models available. Using it to summarize an email is like getting a Lamborghini to deliver a pizza.” – Tom Dotan, WSJ. Models are getting smaller, making them faster to custom train and less costly to call via API, according to CB Insights. Performance gaps are also closing rapidly. For example, Arcee.ai ’s models perform better than ChatGPT for specific use cases. Range of enterprise spend on AI (Source: CBInsights) Custom model options for enterprises (Source: CBInsights) Future offerings could include models such as BloombergGPT, which seems to perform well in tests, but has yet to be meaningfully commercialized. Hybrid: Companies like Alpaca and AlpOps combine elements of both LLMs and vertical applications, offering comprehensive platforms that encompass various functionalities like data analysis, deal sourcing, and portfolio management. This piecemeal approach is much more costly, and firms need to seriously weigh whether this is the best way to make a first foray into AI. Where do we go from here? There is an increasingly popular thesis that custom LLMs will get “squeezed” in the middle, with the top and bottom layers of the stack (applications and compute, respectively) delivering most of the value as models become commoditized. This alone isn’t necessarily a reason to avoid working with LLM developers, but companies hoping to develop a significant moat with large language models alone may end up finding that most of a value ends up coming from a smaller handful of user applications that deliver most of the value, or some better access to data or compute than a smaller competitor. Of the hundreds of senior PE leaders we surveyed, primarily focused on the middle market, at least two thirds of professionals we spoke with told us they were considering purchasing or already using at least one AI application, whether a custom instance of ChatGPT Pro, or a dedicated due diligence system like the one we are building at Keye . Because applications are where we see the most widespread customer adoption and the highest proliferation of startups, this is where the remainder of our deep dive will focus. The Run-Down We have previously made the case that most finance firms can and should adopt AI in some form over the next 2-3 years. Because the space is so early, it is highly possible that at this early stage, your firm might not end up partnering with the provider that will eventually power its AI usage for years to come. But as we wrote about in our second article , sometimes making no decision at all is more costly than making a wrong decision. Simply getting their feet wet, many readers have told us, has brought them immeasurable insights that they are using to learn, iterate and start to build a long-term moat. In service of that goal, we will wrap up with a deeper rundown of each function and some of the players mentioned in our market map at the top of the article: Deal Sourcing : AI is revolutionizing deal sourcing by using predictive analytics to identify investment opportunities based on market trends and historical data. Machine learning models can scan and analyze vast amounts of data to recommend deals that align with strategic investment criteria, thus enhancing the efficiency and scope of sourcing potential investments. Companies like Cyndx and EQT Group's "Motherbrain" are leading the way. Motherbrain, for example, integrates machine learning and big data to grow the digital footprints investors can analyze. This tool has successfully sourced multiple high-value deals and is considered a critical asset within EQT's investment workflow. Due Diligence : In due diligence, AI is accelerating the analysis of financial statements, legal documents, and other pertinent data to quickly assess the health and potential risks associated with an investment. AI-driven tools are highlighting anomalies, predicting future performance based on historical data, and providing comprehensive risk assessments, thereby speeding up the due diligence process and reducing human error. Keye, for example, uses AI to enrich the due diligence process, focusing on quickly extracting insights and identifying risks from large sets of documents. The ultimate goal is to free up time so that investors can consider deals more carefully, and compete with larger firms on a wider set of deals. Co-Pilots & Automators : AI co-pilots and automation tools can streamline repetitive tasks such as data entry, reporting, and even some aspects of decision-making in the investment process. By automating these tasks, AI allows PE firms to focus on strategy and decision-making, improving operational efficiency and reducing costs. Many in this category take a broader approach, such as Blueflame AI. The platform integrates AI and Large Language Models to streamline workflows, manage unstructured data, and assist in crucial tasks like compliance and investor relations. Knowledge & Research : AI can dramatically improve the efficiency and depth of market research and knowledge management. By aggregating and analyzing data from diverse sources, AI-driven tools provide actionable insights and deep analytics, enabling investors to stay ahead of market trends and base their decisions on comprehensive intelligence. Another horizontal solution, Hebbia's technology is distinguished by its ability to execute comprehensive searches over large datasets and provide clear, actionable insights, positioning it as a powerful assistant for knowledge workers. Financial Planning, Auditing & Accounting : AI enhances financial planning by providing more accurate forecasts and modeling scenarios. AI algorithms can analyze market conditions, portfolio performance, and economic indicators to offer real-time financial insights and predictive analytics, aiding in more informed strategic planning and resource allocation. Other functions - data cleaning, portfolio management and operations: Though often not specific to PE, supporting functions that make data analysis easier are an important part of the application stack to consider. While our analysis focuses primarily on investor tools, we are keeping a close eye on the way in which AI will be deployed to transform PortCo operations and boost ROI. How to pick the right partner When considering the adoption of AI-driven solutions in investing functions, firms should strategically prioritize areas where AI can deliver the most significant impact and ROI. Here’s a high-level approach that we have seen work well: Identify pain points and opportunities : Start by assessing which functions are most time-consuming, costly, or prone to errors. Evaluate AI readiness : Assess your current technological infrastructure and the data quality at your firm. You might need to invest in data management and IT infrastructure improvements before they can fully leverage AI capabilities, but you would be surprised at the way in which some applications can help you right out of the gate. Consider compliance and integration challenges : Solutions that offer seamless integration with your existing workflow will cause minimal disruption. Define clear objectives and metrics for success : Before implementing AI solutions, work with your provider to define what success looks like. Have a partnership mentality : Providers should show expertise in the PE sector and a track record with similar clients. A team that is willing to understand your core needs will beat an off-the-shelf solution any time. Start with pilot projects : Implement AI solutions in phases, starting with pilot projects or design partnerships. This approach allows you to manage risks and tweak strategies based on initial outcomes. Successful pilots can then be scaled across other areas of the firm. The AI landscape is vast and ever-changing, but we hope this deeper dive into the space gives you an initial direction to navigate the market. If we can further help you down that path, please reach out to us at Keye and our founders will respond to you directly: founders@keye.co.

title: What is a Microschool and How Do I Start One in Arkansas?
summary: A detailed walkthrough of how you (yes, you!) can start a microschool (now!) in Arkansas.
body_text: Microschools are shaking up the education world in the best way possible! 🎉 These small, community-based schools prioritize personalized learning, flexible pacing, and student empowerment—giving kids an education that actually fits their needs. Unlike traditional schools, microschools offer a more dynamic, hands-on approach where kids can thrive socially and academically. Microschools are growing fast, and Prenda is at the forefront of this movement! As one of the nation’s largest and most trusted microschool networks, Prenda makes it easy and fun to start your own microschool whether you have a professional education background or not (teachers, homeschool mamas, and public school parents- you’re perfect, let’s do this!). While you can absolutely start a microschool independently, it’s a lot harder to do on your own. That’s why we built Prenda—to get all the tricky stuff out. of. your. way. So you can focus on creating a rigorous, yet whimsical , learning environment. 🤯Yes, it’s possible. This guide will walk you through Prenda’s simple 10-step process for launching a microschool in Arkansas—plus, we’ll cover Arkansas’ Education Freedom Account (EFA) program so your students can pay your microschool feels with little to no out-of-pocket cost. Yay! So grab your favorite snack, take a deep breath, and let’s dive into how you can start your microschool adventure in Arkansas! It’s going to be amazing. You’re going to be amazing. 🚀 ‍ Step 1: Get Informed and Determine Your Vision You're already doing step 1! 🎉 Reading up on microschools in your area is essential. We recommend checking out these informative articles: What Are Microschools? (EdChoice) What’s a Microschool and Why Focusing on how Kids Learn is Changing Education. (Stand Together) The Rise of Millennial-Powered Microschools (Getting Smart) Consider your "why" and what type of learning environment you want to create. A significant part of this decision is your educational pedagogy and approach. At Prenda, we believe in empowering students to become self-directed learners who have strong skills and an intrinsic drive to pursue their goals. That said, there are many wonderful and beautiful ways to approach educating children. If Prenda's learning approach doesn't match your vision, that's completely okay! We want the future to be full of diverse educational options that meet everyone's unique needs. So even if you want to go it alone, we hope this process overview is a support to you in your journey! 🧳 Step 2: Set Up Your Microschool To get started, simply click " Start My Microschool " on prenda.com (or open that there link in a new tab…go on now, you got this). Starting this process in no way commits you to starting a microschool IRL. You can explore this whole idea with no commitment and no cost. You’ve got nothing to lose! After you click Start My Microschool, you'll be asked some get-to-know-you questions to help tailor the process to your needs. Follow the prompts to create and account and don’t forget to verify your email. Make sure you use the email address you want for all your Prenda communications and microschool business correspondence. Check your email and verify your account. Easy peasy! 📧 Step 3: Choose Who You Want to Serve Will you open your school to other people's children (the norm), or do you want to start with just your own kids in more of a homeschool setting with Prenda's support? This decision will shape your microschool's structure and growth potential. If you just want to homeschool with Prenda, select "Single-family Microschool," and welcome aboard! But if you want to earn an income as a microschool guide in your community, you’ll select the “Multi-family Microschool” option. Step 4: Select Your Funding Source In Arkansas, you have two primary funding options: direct pay or the Arkansas Children's Educational Freedom Account Program. The EFA program works by redirecting state education dollars to parents, allowing them to decide what type of education works best for their student. The average award amount varies but is approximately $6,800 per student per year. Prenda acts as the vendor and manages all the invoicing and payment collection, so guides (that's what we call our microschool teachers!) don't have to worry about it. All K-12 students in Arkansas are eligible for this scholarship, and funding is universally given to anyone who applies. This makes Arkansas one of the most microschool-friendly states in the country! 👏 For more detailed information about the Arkansas EFA program, check out: Arkansas EFA Program: Everything you need to know Arkansas EFA Details Documentation Step 5: Paperwork and Safety Check At this stage you'll sign something called the "Prenda Platform Agreement." 📜 This is a simple agreement between you and Prenda that just describes the relationship between Prenda and anyone using our products and services—stuff like intellectual property use. You should know that when you use Prenda to power your microschool, you are not an employee or independent contractor. You own and operate your own independent microschool and choose to utilize Prenda's services to assist you. Signing the Prenda Platform Agreement does not commit you to running a microschool. After you sign the agreement, you'll initiate a background check for you and for any other adults that will be present during school hours. Prenda handles all the logistics and the expense of providing background checks, all you have to do is fill out your information which takes about 2 minutes. ✅ Step 6: Find a Location and Decide How Much You Will Charge As a microschool founder, you're responsible for finding your own location. The location needs to be safe for kids and have internet access. Think about creating an environment where kids can feel comfortable, be creative, and play. Many Prenda microschools operate out of homes, giving them an intimate, cozy vibe. Others use dance studios, tutoring centers, or even barns and outdoor spaces! 🏡 Here are just a few of the locations where people have run Prenda microschools... Locations Slideshow by Marketing & Media Once you have a location, it's time to decide what your income will be. Prenda guides set their own per-student rate, allowing each microschool founder to control their income. This "guide fee" is typically around $3,500-$4,000 per student. In addition, Prenda charges a $2,199 per-student fee, bringing the total cost for families to between &5,700-$6,200 per year. 😳 While this may seem high, it's actually much less than public school per student spending, private school tuition, and other child-focused services like daycare. Plus, 99% of Prenda students use state-funded school choice scholarships, covering the cost entirely. Check out Prenda's income calculator to see how much you could earn as a microschool guide. Is Prenda worth the money? YES! We provide comprehensive training, one-on-one coaching, and access to a supportive guide community—all at no upfront cost. Our package includes K-8th curriculum for all subjects, academic coaching, and a microschool management system that makes running your school so easy. We even handle invoicing and payment collection, so you can focus on creating an exceptional learning environment. And instead of nickel and diming you with start up fees, service charges, and coaching expenses, we provide all our services with no upfront cost to you. All of our service fees are baked into that per student Prenda fee, so we only make money when you successfully launch your microschool. Pretty sweet deal, eh? We’re in your corner, no matter what. 🚩 Check out our Curriculum Overview and Guide Toolkit for a deeper dive into what you get. Step 7: Build Your Microschool Profile and Start Outreach Once you have a location and your guide fee is set, you can use Prenda's profile builder to create your microschool profile. This profile gets linked to Prenda's microschool marketplace, which is a map of all the microschools. This makes it easy for prospective parents to find you! You can also use your profile link to text to friends or post on social media. Check out the map of existing microschools here: Find a Microschool As you find interested families, all you have to do is send them an invite to join your school. They'll fill out a quick form, and bam—you'll see them pop up in your Prenda account, ready for school! Step 8: Prenda Guide Certification Training This step-by-step training will teach you more about Prenda's learning system and how kids will learn at your microschool. You'll also get sample schedules and a detailed checklist of things to help prepare you and your students for a successful year. This information will equip you to talk to parents and grow your school. 📚 At Prenda, we provide a research-aligned learning approach that allows every student to progress at their own pace without creating detrimental academic learning gaps or limiting beliefs about themselves as learners. Learning at Prenda is hands-on and focused on building real-world skills and academic mastery. 💡It's rigorous, but fun! Step 9: Your Kick-off Party Hold a school kick-off party with new students and families to get to know each other. Prenda provides details on how to run a successful school kick-off and orientation party so everyone is set up and ready for the first day. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Creating a sense of belonging from day one sets the tone for a thriving microschool community. Step 10: Start School! What an exciting day this will be! 🎊 Microschool life is truly magical—kids get to be kids while still learning the skills they need to prepare them for the world, all without losing their love of learning. You get to watch them grow, inspire them, coach them, and cheer them on. The Prenda team will continue to support you year-round. If you have any questions or run into any issues, both our team and our guide community are here to help. You’re never alone. ‍ Want to learn more about how this all works? Drop your email to get immediate access to our free overview webinar "Microschooling 101." And if you want to hear the story of Prenda's founding and get a better sense of how the microschooling movement is revolutionizing education, check out this video... ‍ ‍

title: July 2026 Scent Horoscope
summary: July is an invitation to slow down and savor each moment, mostly because Mercury retrograde has other ideas. Instead of fighting the cosmic static, we’re romanticizing the pause with grounding, nos…
body_text: July is an invitation to slow down and savor each moment, mostly because Mercury retrograde has other ideas. Instead of fighting the cosmic static, we’re romanticizing the pause with grounding, nostalgic scents. Find your July match below. Aries: Etat Libre d’Orange She Was an Anomaly Pack your bags, Aries, but maybe leave the fireworks to somebody else this year. She Was an Anomaly thrives on the unexpected, all bright twists and creamy woods, which is fortunate because your best July stories won’t come from the trip you planned. Taurus: Strawberry Shortcake x Scentbird Orange Blossom If your friends can’t find you, tell them to check the nearest campsite. Orange Blossom smells like sunshine, a huge dollop of orange marmelade, and the nostalgia of childhood summers, making it the perfect pick for a month spent ghosting group chats in favor of gazing at actual stars. Gemini: Michel Germain Orange Blossom Garden & French Vanilla Mercury retrograde wants your credit card details. Orange blossom and French vanilla want absolutely nothing from you except a wrist to live on, which is significantly cheaper. Cancer: Maison Louis Marie No.14 Icila Happy birthday, Cancer. Since the stars are practically demanding a wardrobe refresh, you might as well smell the part too. No.14 Icila pairs juicy ruby pamplemousse with dark plum and vanilla flower, like the fragrance equivalent of leaving your old self in last season’s closet. Leo: Love Island x Scentbird Love Island The spotlight’s taking a quick coffee break, but don’t get too comfortable backstage. Love Island, with all its peachy flirtation, heavy charm, dripping yuzu, and bare skin musk, is already warming up for your inevitable return. Virgo: Ex Nihilo Spiky Muse Virgo, listen: Nobody’s questioning your standards, but the stars are encouraging a little emotional availability this month: nothing dramatic, just a tad of entertaining the idea of letting somebody in. Spiky Muse brings juicy strawberry into the mix alongside sharp pistachio and cedarwood, because getting out of comfort zones is fun. Libra: Matière Première French Flower The promotion, compliment, opportunity, or lucky break you’ve been manifesting finally shows up, and yes, you should absolutely tell everyone about it. French Flower practically arrives carrying a congratulatory bouquet, filled to the brim with sultry tuberose. Scorpio: Kenzo L’Eau Ambrée Not every masterpiece requires a dramatic drum roll and the whole shebang. L’Eau Ambrée unfolds slowly, amber glowing beneath watery freshness, much like the project you’ve been perfecting in the shadows while everyone else was busy bragging about theirs. Sagittarius: Gisada Donna A little extra cash lands in your orbit this month, Sagittarius, and the stars fully support spending some of it on fun. Just a portion. Donna’s blend of juicy fruits, white florals, and vanilla is proof that treating yourself can, in fact, be an investment in morale. We know you’ll spend it on plane tickets, so go ahead, book that trip now. Capricorn: Nopalera Bosque Místico Some romances appear all glowing and loud like fireworks, but you’re not like the others. Yours appears to be taking the scenic route, smelling faintly of smoky woods, courtesy of Bosque Místico. Aquarius: DedCool Mochi Milk Your next big idea will arrive while you’re doing absolutely nothing productive, Aquarius, so leave room for a little daydreaming. Or binge watching. Mochi Milk wraps creamy milk, rice notes, and soft sweetness into a perfume that smells very comfortably posh, which feels very on-brand for you. Pisces: Cayla Gray Water Your assignment for July is simple, Pisces: NO DRAMA. Water is a cocktail of airy aquatic notes and soft florals, creating a gentle ripple effect that turns self-care into a full-blown lifestyle. All while smelling amazing, to boot.

body_text: OpenAI, l'organizzazione di ricerca che ha sviluppato ChatGPT e la loro stessa creazione, sono da settimane al centro di moltissime discussioni e discorsi sui social media e non solo: OpenAI ha registrato più di un milione di interazioni sui social nel mese di gennaio 2023 – raddoppiando i numeri generati nell'intero quarto trimestre del 2022 (da ottobre a dicembre). Per ChatGPT, i numeri sono ancora più alti, con 9,2 milioni di action nel gennaio 2023 e un aumento del 330% rispetto al Q4 2022. In che modo le persone accedono a ChatGPT? Un’indicazione la si può ricavare dal numero di persone che hanno visitato il sito web di OpenAI, da desktop o mobile. In particolare, OpenAI.com ha registrato oltre 1,4 milioni di visitatori unici in Italia nel solo mese di gennaio 2023, 905 mila visitatori unici attraverso mobile e i restanti 523mila da desktop. Sono proprio gli utenti che vi accedono da desktop a trascorrere più tempo sul sito - 11,1 minuti per visitatore al mese rispetto a 9,7 minuti per visitatore al mese da mobile. Caratteristiche dei visitatori di OpenAI.com Nette differenze tra le fasce d’età dei visitatori di OpenAI evidenziano come il pubblico con un’età compresa tra i 15 e i 24 anni sia il più rappresentato: la reach di OpenAI all'interno di questo gruppo (al 10,4%) è 3,23 volte superiore (indice di composizione UV = 323) rispetto alla reach media su Internet (al 3,2%). Il grande hype generato da ChatGPT ha spinto OpenAI.com tra i primi 150 siti e app più visitati in Italia, in particolare grazie agli uomini di età compresa tra 15 e 24 anni. Tuttavia, in termini di engagement, questo target ha speso in media solo 13,1 minuti al mese sul sito, significativamente meno delle 23 ore al mese trascorse su Tiktok o delle 11 ore al mese trascorse sul sito di YouTube. Più interessante il paragone con siti di alto profilo come Wikipedia (11,2 minuti), siti di testate giornalistiche come Gazzetta Dello Sport e Fanpage.it (5,1 e 3,5 minuti, rispettivamente). Ottiene risultati di engagement migliori anche di OnlyFans (4,2 minuti). Definizioni *Total Action: numero di action (reaction, condivisioni, commenti, retweet, preferiti, mi piace) calcolati su Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, and YouTube. ** L'indice di composizione UV confronta la proporzione di un profilo utente su un determinato sito con la proporzione di questo profilo su tutto Internet. Quindi, se un profilo utente corrisponde al 20% del pubblico di un sito ma al 10% di tutti gli utenti di Internet, allora l’indice di composizione UV = 20% / 10% x 100 = 200 Ulteriori informazioni Audience Measurement Cross-Platform Engagement Social Prodotti Associati Misurazione dei contenuti multipiattaforma Consulta dati completi e non duplicati sulle modalità di fruizione di contenuti su diversi dispositivi da parte delle audience digitali Richiesta demo Total Digital Comscore Total Digital fornisce un'intelligenza digitale completa su Web, dispositivi mobili e social con un'interfaccia intuitiva e sempre attiva. title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now in scope for FedRAMP Moderate
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon Aurora DSQL is now in scope for FedRAMP Moderate
body_text: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now in scope for FedRAMP Moderate in the US East (Ohio), US East (N. Virginia), and US West (Oregon) Regions. You can now use Aurora DSQL to build applications and run workloads that are subject to FedRAMP Moderate compliance requirements. The Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) is a US government-wide program that delivers a standard approach to the security assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring for cloud products and services. Amazon Aurora DSQL is the fastest serverless, distributed SQL database, with active-active high availability and multi-Region strong consistency. It enables you to build always-available applications with virtually unlimited scale, the highest availability, and zero infrastructure management. To learn more about FedRAMP , visit the AWS services in scope page . To learn more about Amazon Aurora DSQL, visit the Aurora DSQL webpage and documentation .

title: Sample availability for electronic components and design intent conversion
body_text: Most design projects need to go through a series of prototyping processes before going into a mass production stage and final release to consumers. These prototypes are made in different stages of the design process to ensure that the functionality of the finished product is the desired one. In the electronics space, components suppliers help engineers in their prototyping stages by providing free samples of their components. At SnapEDA, we want to help engineers get those free samples, in addition to the ECAD and MCAD models, to expedite the design process. The image below shows how engineers can find free samples from the components they’re looking at including in their designs. ‍ Figure 1. Part page of component with free samples available for request on SnapEDA ‍ But is having free samples on suppliers part pages on SnapEDA something that might influence the design intent of engineers? We analyzed the data from hundreds of thousands of downloads happening on our site to understand if sample availability is affecting download conversion among our engineering community, and what we found is very interesting. The chart below shows the likelihood of an engineer to design-in an electronic component evaluated on SnapEDA . As shown, for every component evaluated, about 30% of parts get designed-in. ‍ Figure 2. Average part evaluation conversion to download on SnapEDA, in the last 7 weeks We had previously shown how the availability of MCAD models was one of the strongest variables that affected the design intent of engineers downloading on SnapEDA. However, we also found that having free samples available for request, right when the engineers are browsing for the components they need in their design, also greatly affects their design intent . Below, you’ll find a chart showing that parts with free samples available for request, have a 54% higher probability of being designed-in. ‍ Figure 3. Average conversion to download with sample availability ‍ We understand how prototyping is crucial for product design and development. We also now understand that providing the samples needed for this prototyping in early stages of the design can also influence engineering design intent in the electronic space. Offering free samples to engineers on SnapEDA If you want to offer free samples for your components to the largest community of professional engineers selecting and designing-in parts, take a look at our Media Kit . ‍ About SnapEDA SnapEDA is a platform used by 1 million professional engineers to design-in components. Are your parts on SnapEDA? Get started with our free InstaPublish service.

body_text: So you've picked a plan from Claude AI pricing , created your account, and now you're trying to use Claude at the pace your work actually demands. For developers, clinicians, and knowledge workers, the bottleneck is rarely Claude itself. It's the input. Speaking through your device's built-in dictation works to a point, but correction loops add up fast on longer prompts, technical vocabulary, or any workflow where the detail matters as much as the speed. Here's what it looks like when the input is set up properly. TLDR: Claude offers built-in Voice mode on supported mobile apps, while desktop users can also use system dictation (Mac: Fn+Fn, Windows: Win+H) or third-party voice dictation tools. Claude Pro costs $20/month and raises usage limits; the free tier works for casual use but caps out fast for daily users. Claude excels at long documents and complex reasoning; ChatGPT has a broader ecosystem of built-in tools, connectors, image generation, and integrations. Specialized voice dictation tools let you speak Claude prompts at 150 WPM vs. 40 WPM typing, with ~200ms latency across Mac, Windows, and iOS. How to Sign In and Create Your Claude AI Account Getting started with Claude requires an account through Anthropic's website or the Claude app. The process takes under two minutes regardless of which sign-in method you choose. Creating Your Account Visit claude.ai and select "Sign up." You have three options: Sign up with Google for the fastest setup, linking your existing Google account without a separate password. Sign up with Apple ID if you prefer Apple's authentication ecosystem. Sign up with email and password for a standalone Anthropic account unconnected to other services. Claude AI Plans and Pricing: Free, Pro, Max, and Team Anthropic offers four tiers for Claude, and knowing which one fits your situation saves you from either overpaying or hitting frustrating usage walls mid-conversation. Here is a quick breakdown of what each plan covers: The free tier gives you access to Claude via the web and app with a daily message limit. It is a reasonable starting point for casual use, but heavy users will notice the cap fairly quickly. Claude Pro runs at $20 per month and raises usage limits substantially, adds priority access during peak hours, and unlocks Projects for organizing ongoing conversations. Claude Max comes in at $100 per month (5x usage) or $200 per month (20x usage) for users who need consistent, high-volume output without hitting limits. The Team plan is $30 per user per month and adds a shared workspace, higher context windows, and admin controls for managing members, making it the right fit for professional teams coordinating across ongoing projects. For most people trying Claude for the first time, the free tier is the right place to start. Pro makes sense once you are using Claude daily for writing, research, or analysis and finding the caps disruptive. How to Download the Claude AI App Claude is available across every major device, and no single download covers all of them. There are a few different ways to get it depending on where you work: iOS: Search "Claude" in the App Store and install the official Anthropic app. It's free to download and connects to your account automatically on sign-in. Android: Find it in the Google Play Store by searching "Claude." Same free download, same account access. Browser: claude.ai works in any current browser with no installation required, making it the fastest starting point for most new users. Mac: A native desktop app is available from anthropic.com for a dedicated window outside the browser. Windows: Anthropic offers a Windows desktop app from their site, giving Windows users the same experience as Mac. The mobile apps include free tier access once you sign in. How to Use Claude AI Voice Mode Claude now offers a built-in Voice mode on supported mobile apps with microphone support. Desktop users can use system dictation or third-party voice dictation tools when interacting with Claude, while the web interface primarily relies on typed input or your device's built-in dictation features. What you can do is use your device's system-level dictation to speak your prompts into Claude's text field. On iPhone or Android, tap the microphone on your keyboard, speak your message, and the transcribed text goes into the Claude input box. On Windows or Mac, system dictation works the same way across any text field, including Claude's chat interface. If you want a faster, more accurate version of this workflow, voice-to-text tools for developers and professional teams sit as a layer on top of Claude and every other app in your stack. Where the keyboard mic falls short, these tools learn domain vocabulary over time, whether that's codebase references for an engineering team, clinical terminology for a healthcare provider, or client and project names for a knowledge worker, and process audio fast enough that text appears before the next thought forms, across Windows, Mac, and iOS. How to Talk to Claude AI for Coding: Claude Code Voice Mode Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line assistant, launched a Claude Code voice mode in March 2026. Activate it by typing /voice in the terminal on Mac or Windows. See the Claude Code voice dictation docs for version requirements, then hold to speak and release to send. Claude transcribes your input and processes it as a standard text prompt, returning output in the terminal as usual. The push-to-talk model fits naturally into tasks that are slow or awkward to type: Explaining a bug while looking directly at it, so the context stays intact instead of getting compressed into a terse comment Providing architectural reasoning before a major refactor, where the thinking matters as much as the instruction Narrating multi-step agentic tasks without losing detail to typing friction, which matters most in team environments where full context needs to carry across handoffs Describing edge cases in full, without forcing them into shorthand that strips out the nuance. For Cursor users, AI voice dictation for Cursor makes this kind of narration fast and friction-free. Claude AI vs ChatGPT: How They Compare Both Claude and ChatGPT are capable AI assistants, but they are built around different priorities that become apparent depending on how you use them. Claude, made by Anthropic, tends to perform better on tasks that require careful reasoning, longer context windows, and precise instruction-following. ChatGPT, made by OpenAI, has a broader ecosystem of plugins, tools, and integrations that many users find useful for general-purpose work. Here is a practical breakdown of how they compare across the dimensions that matter most to everyday users: Feature Claude ChatGPT Context window Up to 200K tokens (Claude 3.5+) Varies by model and plan; many current ChatGPT models support up to 128K tokens Reasoning quality Strong on complex, multi-step tasks Strong general-purpose reasoning Tone Measured, thorough, cautious Conversational, direct Free tier Available with usage limits Available with usage limits Built-in tools & integrations Limited third-party integrations Broad plugin and tool ecosystem Best for Long documents, detailed writing, analysis Broad tasks, coding, image generation Neither is universally better. If your work involves processing long documents, detailed research, or careful instruction-following, Claude tends to hold up better. Learn how voice dictation in Claude can speed up your interactions regardless of which assistant you favor. If you rely on third-party integrations or image generation, ChatGPT's ecosystem gives it an edge. For a deeper look at where each tool lands, Zapier's Claude vs ChatGPT comparison covers the tradeoffs in detail. Claude AI Customer Support: How to Get Help Anthropic does not operate a customer service phone number for Claude. Searches for a direct support line or publicly listed support email will come up empty because neither exists. Support runs through web-based channels only. Here is how to reach the right one depending on your issue: The Help Center at support.claude.ai covers account setup, billing questions, and common technical issues through self-serve documentation. In-product feedback lets you flag a specific response or report a bug directly from the Claude interface. Billing and refund requests go through a support ticket form at support.claude.ai, where you can submit account-specific requests including refund claims. Free tier users are directed primarily to the Help Center. Pro, Max, and Team subscribers can submit support tickets directly and typically see faster turnaround on billing disputes and refund requests.
